rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something straight, line-shaped, or following a direct course.

example.english: This road follows a linear course all the way to the waterfront.
example.traditional: 呢條路一路直線去到海旁。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 lou6 jat1 lou6 zik6 sin3 heoi3 dou3 hoi2 pong4

rows.note: Use this technical term for sequential systems, degree-one mathematics, operation-preserving maps, and scheduled broadcast media rather than for physical shape.

example.english: This program uses a linear design, so the steps must be completed in sequence.
example.traditional: 呢個程式係線性設計，步驟要逐級完成。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 hai6 sin3 sing3 cit3 gai3 bou6 zaau6 jiu3 zuk6 kap1 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an object that is long and narrow with roughly parallel sides, rather than merely straight.

example.english: This sponge has a linear shape and fits perfectly into the gap.
example.traditional: 呢塊長條形海綿啱啱好塞得入個罅隙。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 coeng4 tiu4 jing4 hoi2 min4 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 sak1 dak1 jap6 go3 laa3 kwik1
